queries: select p.category, date_trunc('week',l.date) w, count(*) n from lost_sale l join product p on p.id=l.product_id where l.date>='2025-02-24' group by 1,2 order by 2,1
select supplier_id, category, count(*) n from purchase_order group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select date_trunc('week',order_date) w, round(avg(is_late::int),2) late, round(avg(is_short::int),2) short, round(avg(delay_days),1) d, count(*) n from purchase_order where category='notebook' and order_date>='2025-03-24' group by 1 order by 1
